title: Session handoff: quest 0.13.0 bump ready on #486, held until lore 0.13.0 is on npm
description:
Session handoff for the successor, 2026-10-02, third session, written at opum-agent's request for the recycle gate.

WHERE THE WORK IS. opum-ai/quest-cli#486 is OPEN against dev, head 4569aa38 on branch chore/QCLI-433-bump-0-13-0, fully pushed. QCLI-433 is In Progress and carries three notes worth reading before anything else: the boundary note (what is ready, the one red gate and why it is not a defect in the work, what was verified locally, how the binaries were obtained, what is deliberately left to the tier-3 steps), the full-suite result, and the pair-sequencing ruling.

THE ONE RED. lore check fails with "the lore 0.12.0 / quest 0.13.0 pair version requirement is not met: lore 0.12.0 requires quest 0.12.0", exit 6. .github/workflows/lore-check.yml line 159 hardcodes `npm install -g @opum-ai/lore@0.12.0`, so the job cannot install the lore a quest 0.13.0 tree requires. Tracker integrity is success on the same head, and the three commits themselves are verified locally: check:packages exit 0, check:lockfile 6 of 6, test:packages exit 0, all six binary digests matching both their manifests and the root map, the breaking-bump pair check, and bun run check exit 0 (1076 + 14 pass).

THE HOLD, and it is the successor's first instruction. Change nothing on #486 until opum-agent reports that lore 0.13.0 is on npm. Then, in order: lore-cli's LCLI-665 moves its QUEST_SOURCE_REF to a verified quest-cli commit carrying 0.13.0 (7f567a67, or whatever #486 heads at by then); lore 0.13.0 is tagged and published through the operator's own dialog in lore-cli; the lore-check pin moves from 0.12.0 to 0.13.0 riding IN #486 rather than a follow-up, keeping the workflow header's invariant -- regenerate the committed .lore schemas with that same lore and measure the regenerated tree with `npx --yes @opum-ai/lore@0.13.0` before choosing the landing shape, exactly as QCLI-422 did; then #486 goes green and lands.

TIER 3, after that, in this repository's own dialog and none of it started: the Unreleased -> 0.13.0 changelog rename with its fresh successor heading at tag time; the v0.13.0 tag; the receipt-gated publish, staged under release-candidate, after lore-cli's main reads 0.13.0 and the operator authorizes; receipt:verify-published; and the dev-to-main fast-forward promotion. Nothing is tagged, staged, published or promoted.

ARTIFACTS. The six CI-built packages are under /tmp/qcli433-artifacts, downloaded from qualification run 37073166852. That run's artifact retention is 7 days from 2026-10-02, so they expire around 2026-10-09; if the bytes must be re-derived after that, re-dispatch prepublication-qualification.yml against the branch.

ALSO OPEN, ADJACENT. The board build choices -- the across-refs toggle, repository discovery through userConfig, the uncommitted-window banner, and the Reference layout -- are under opum-doc review and must not change while it runs (operator instruction 2026-10-02, opum-agent OPAG-1086).

SKILLS THE SUCCESSOR SHOULD REACH FOR: opum-sdlc before branch or merge work, docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md for the tag-time steps and the darwin-arm64 execution ordering, opum-quest for tracker writes, opum-lore for the bundle.
